g.text: Scenario 5, fold 5: a severe annual-policy episode
OOF client C | H = 30 | fixed target (equity, bond, bill) = (45%, 15%, 40%)
Annual policy: 57.7% MDD | peak year 1 to trough year 7 | recovered in year 18
Selected as annual restore's worst original OOF client-C path; this example cannot rank overall policy quality.
Shading: annual peak-to-trough episode. Dotted loss line: C's 40% tolerance. Equal thirds uses a different target.
Saved execution artifacts only; annual observations, actual transfers and fees. No intrayear price path is inferred.
